purpose: Sample the original-STS KSP aerodynamic wrench model across high-AoA shadow-trace altitude slices, Mach estimates, sideslip, and bank.

qualification.note: All returned forces and torques are counterfactual KSP simulations. They are not flight measurements, a shadow-gate pass, or landing qualification.

provenance.apiUt: Each retained shadow trace UT is passed to the wrench call. The target latitude/longitude is reconstructed from runway-relative along/cross offsets, then its KSC local frame is rotated from current paused UT using measured body angular velocity.
provenance.machPolicy: Mach labels use the nearest recorded ENTRY_WITNESS V/M speed of sound at each trace slice; exact ENTRY_TRACE TAS is also sampled. The wrench API accepts velocity rather than Mach.
provenance.densityAndDynamicPressurePolicy: KSP atmospheric_density_at_position is queried at the reconstructed future inertial point using live paused UT; wrench calculations use the trace UT explicitly. The density query UT and wrench ephemeris UT are both recorded; q is computed as 0.5*rho*V^2.
provenance.angularVelocityPolicy: Zero hypothetical vessel angular velocity to isolate static aerodynamic force and moment; no damping moment is included.
provenance.surfaceStatePolicy: Use current original-STS parts and neutral control surfaces. No control, action group, throttle, RCS, SAS, save, position, velocity, orientation, or time setters are called.

gridDefinition.bankConvention: KSP Flight.roll for the original STS, calibrated from its loaded 72 km checkpoint attitude; the loaded checkpoint local +Z axis is opposite radial up.

loadedMassAssessment.massUsedForDragAcceleration: Checkpoint profile mass; it agrees within 1 kg with the settled live vessel mass.
loadedMassAssessment.torqueLimitation: The returned torque is a hypothetical static KSP aerodynamic result about the settled vessel center of mass, not measured flight torque or actuator response.
